specs_json.compute: DJI flight controller; O3 Enterprise transmission

notes: DJI's flagship enterprise platform for inspection, public safety, and mapping, supporting up to three gimbal payloads (Zenmuse H20T/P1/L2 etc.). Dual hot-swappable TB65 batteries give up to 55 min flight; IP55 rated with O3 Enterprise link up to 20 km. Introduced May 2023 as the M300 RTK successor.

failure_modes.name: Gimbal connector/ribbon failure
failure_modes.symptoms: Payload not recognized, gimbal drift, video dropouts
failure_modes.mitigation: Inspect DGC 2.0 connector, avoid hot-swapping payloads with power on, keep seals clean

failure_modes.name: TB65 battery cell imbalance
failure_modes.symptoms: Voltage delta warnings, shortened flight time, forced RTH
failure_modes.mitigation: Use battery station storage mode, cycle pairs together, retire packs past 400 cycles

failure_modes.name: Propeller icing / heavy rain ingress
failure_modes.symptoms: Vibration alarm, attitude instability in precipitation
failure_modes.mitigation: Respect IP55 limits (no icing), pre-flight weather check, carry spare props

failure_modes.name: O3 link interference in urban RF
failure_modes.mitigation: Use 5.8 GHz where legal, dual operator antennas elevated, plan LOS routes

failure_modes.name: RTK antenna multipath near steel structures
failure_modes.symptoms: Float solutions during inspections, waypoint drift
failure_modes.mitigation: Blend vision positioning, increase standoff distance, use D-RTK 2 base

failure_modes.name: Obstacle sensor blinding by sun glare
failure_modes.symptoms: Missed obstacle warnings at low sun angles
failure_modes.mitigation: Plan flights avoiding sun-aligned approaches, keep sensors clean, enable radar option
